_comment: An entry belongs here only when a package is CORRECT to declare a third-party
distribution its src/ tree never imports -- i.e. the package needs the
distribution's EXECUTABLE (it runs it as a subprocess) rather than its Python
API. A distribution that is merely 'used by the projects this package
generates' is never exempted: that is the generated project's dependency.
Each entry names the package, the distribution and the reason. An entry
that no longer matches a declared-but-unimported distribution is stale and
fails the gate. expected_count must equal the number of entries: remediation
removes the entry and decrements the count in the same change.

exemptions.reason: hooks/language_hooks.py runs `ruff check --fix` / `ruff format` as a subprocess over the generated Python project (the language post-processing hook); the ruff module is never imported. The executable must be installed with the generator, so it is declared.
